cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium & General Assembly 2027
cand.excerpt: Top candidate: local, multi-day, international association mechanism with unconfirmed hotel sourcing.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Commercially relevant organizer contacts, not verified hotel-contract buyers: Agathe Lairy and Marie Arduin are named together in the 2026 official programme under OENOVITI International Network Team, using oenoviti@u-bordeaux.fr. Agathe also publicly promotes the 2027 Swiss edition. Pierre-Louis Teissedre is identified on the current official contact page as Head of OENOVITI International and in the programme as coordinator. Johanna Dayer is Changins Responsable Communication et Marketing, a local-host routing contact. No source establishes that any of them controls a 2027 hotel contract.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition within the requested horizon: 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland. Theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing environmental, social and human challenges. These are activity dates, explicitly published by the network and Agroscope, not article dates. Agroscope lists registration opening on 1 December 2026 at 00:01. No officially announced 2028 edition was located; do not invent dates or assume a Swiss return.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL product brief: local Nyon / La Côte demand is territorially relevant to Founex, unlike downtown-Geneva megashow housing. The realistic 2027 role is alternative individual accommodation or a modest organizer-approved allocation, potentially with separately agreed transfers. The published meeting venue is already Changins, so do not count conference-room or whole-event relocation revenue. The organizer reported 97 participants in Porto in 2026, a historical scale indicator only, not a 2027 forecast or 97 guestrooms. No 2027 attendance or room demand supports a quantified block, a 20–120-room forecast, or use of the whole 237-room hotel. This is not evidence of resort-format demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Agroscope explicitly lists the location as Changins and the organizers as OENOVITI International, Agroscope and University of Applied Sciences Changins. Venue: Changins | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie; its current official contact address is Route de Duillier 52, CH-1260 Nyon. Territory: Nyon / La Côte, Vaud, Switzerland, not Geneva city or Lausanne. The published institutional venue is not a competing hotel; no signed venue contract or exact room allocation is disclosed. Agroscope is a co-host, not evidence of a separate second meeting venue.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent sequence: Asti, Italy, 14–15 May 2024, Asti University Campus / Uni-Astiss; Vienna, Austria, 22–23 May 2025, BOKU Ilse-Wallentin-Haus; Porto, Portugal, 20–22 May 2026, Faculty of Sciences of the University of Porto / Ferreira da Silva Auditorium; announced Nyon, Switzerland, 19–21 May 2027, Changins. The network explicitly describes the symposium and general assembly as annual. This establishes recurrence and recent international rotation, not annual Nyon demand.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Participant-direct booking with an edition-specific recommended hotel, not wholly unknown sourcing. OENOVITI states: "OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings" and "We recommend booking your accommodation at Hôtel B&B NYON" at 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon. It adds: "Activities will depart and return to this location." Corporate code: NOVITI27. Agroscope explicitly states: "You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs." B&B HOTEL Nyon / Hôtel B&B NYON is the only hotel named in the retrieved 2027 accommodation guidance. No room allocation, guaranteed block, rate, cutoff, housing bureau or open RFP is published. The code proves an event-specific booking pathway, not contracted inventory or exclusivity.
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI is an international scientific/academic and industry network in viticulture and oenology, administered by an Executive Committee. Its Bordeaux coordination office is explicitly the main contact for event organization. ADERA handles membership collections, network finances and project-management support. Changins and Agroscope are the 2027 institutional co-hosts. No PCO, DMC or housing agency is identified. Correct the seed sports_entertainment classification to scientific / professional viticulture-and-oenology symposium and network general assembly; formal legal association status is not established by these pages.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B HOTEL Nyon has a documented edition-specific recommendation, participant identification code and activity departure/return role. This is a real competitive advantage over alternative Founex lodging; attendees at YOTEL would need a workable connection to the designated pickup point or host-approved alternative. No evidence of B&B sell-out, capacity shortage, overflow, rate disadvantage, exclusivity or guaranteed rooms was found. Do not sell this internally as proven overflow.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Before the published 1 December 2026 registration opening, contact Agathe Lairy and Marie Arduin together via the published OENOVITI team address; copy or seek introduction to Johanna Dayer for local routing. Acknowledge B&B HOTEL Nyon and NOVITI27 rather than pitching a replacement venue. Ask whether an optional YOTEL participant rate may be circulated, whether any hotel allocation is guaranteed or exclusive, expected non-local overnight attendance, arrival/departure patterns, and the exact pickup/transfer requirements. Offer only an availability-checked, modest allocation and separately costed transport if requested. Do not claim a block, shuttle or demand volume until agreed. Escalate network-level partnership questions to Pierre-Louis Teissedre; do not imply purchasing authority.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition remains accessible for participant-choice lodging because Agroscope explicitly permits alternatives. However, the recommended hotel and activity logistics are already established. Accessibility therefore means permission to pursue alternative accommodation, not an open sourcing process, organizer endorsement of YOTEL, or a committed group block. As of the supplied 16 November 2026 reference date, registration is scheduled to open on 1 December 2026.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: use 2027 to build relationships with the network coordination office and local hosts for future Changins/Agroscope workshops or any later Swiss-hosted edition. Annual recurrence does not establish repeat local demand: the verified recent editions rotate internationally. No 2028 city, venue or dates were located. Future event capture is conditional relationship development, not qualified recurring Nyon room nights.
